notes: Captured on studio 9de40e5 (the live dot draws); the coordinator's Release WebAssembly publish of 9de40e5 for the shipped seed.
Heroes: focus-badge (a pick) and stylized-seeds (the next strongest); stylized-split, the other pick, has no hero by the owner's brief change of 2026-11-09.
Captures run on a paused page clock stepped one 16 ms frame at a time, with the app's Random() fed seeded entropy (2026), so every session and build shows the same feed and value (140.33).
stylized-seeds uses three extra builds of 9de40e5 that change only PrimarySeed in App.xaml (#2196F3, #FF5722, #9C27B0); real output, built one at a time and deleted after capture.
Sessions can start one 20 ms clock step apart (about a frame of easing); frames were matched by line masks, and the Light and Dark desktops in the split agree.
focus-easing and stylized-motion show the badge text ahead of its position on purpose: the control's designed easing, not canvas lag.
Showcase banners carry axis labels of 4 to 7 px at 1x; readable text is in the focused banners.
The portrait phones and the 1180x820 tablets show the one-card page with a lot of Background: the app's real layout.
Studio info-file screenshots (Light, settled, dot visible) are in studiolive/: chart-desktop.png 1280x800 and chart-phone.png 390x844, both at deviceScaleFactor 1.
